description.en: Pools a Vibe Code sign-in: browser OIDC authorization, then OpenAI and Responses traffic plus the API and Vibe monthly budgets, with automatic token refresh.
description.zh: 把 Vibe Code 的 Mistral 登录态接入网关：浏览器 OIDC 授权后，OpenAI / Responses 与 API / Vibe 双额度都按账号池化，续期自动完成。

docs.en: Sign in with your Mistral account and authorize the public Vibe Code CLI client. Usage follows your plan; the gateway stores only the OIDC tokens and refreshes them before expiry.
docs.zh: 在浏览器登录 Mistral 账号并授权 Vibe Code CLI 的公开客户端即可。账号的额度随计划走；网关只保存 OIDC 令牌，并在过期前自动刷新。

description.en: Authorize your Mistral account in the browser. Sign-in finishes as soon as the callback arrives.
description.zh: 在浏览器登录并授权 Mistral 账号，回调到达后自动完成，无需复制地址。
